follower.name: Father of Dragons
follower.text: Attacks, spells, scrolls, shouts and enchantments are up to 30% better against dragons (based on favor with Akatosh). Able to craft a powerful amulet by using amulets of the Eight Divines.

devotee.name: Turn the Hourglass
devotee.text: Praying to Akatosh resets the cooldown of your most recently used shout and power. Craft a powerful amulet with 5 of each of the nine divines amulets.

tenets.name: Tenets of Akatosh
tenets.text: Fulfill your destiny by saving Tamriel. Raise your character level. Absorb dragon souls. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.

follower.name: Wellspring of Life
follower.text: Bonuses from The All Maker Stones are doubled. Gain up to 10% weapon damage while having an unused All Maker Stone Power.

devotee.name: World Shaman
devotee.text: After using an All-Maker Stone power, pray to the All-Maker to have it restored to you. Doomstone effects are doubled (Stacks with Aetherial Crown)

tenets.name: Tenets of the All-Maker
tenets.text: Cleanse the All-Maker Stones. Hunt animals. Explore new locations. Pray only outdoors. Nords are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Face-Snaked Queen
follower.text: Attacks deal up to 20% more damage to enemies who are facing you and take up to 20% less damage while blocking (based on favor with Almalexia).

devotee.name: Ayem's Mercy
devotee.text: Healing from most spells and potions is up to 20% better and wards are up to 30% cheaper to cast. (based on favor with Almalexia)

tenets.name: Tenets of Almalexia
tenets.text: Vanquish the threats facing Solstheim. Be generous to beggars and children. Receive the blessing of Lover's Comfort. Dark Elves are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Chalice of Life
follower.text: Regenerate up to 5% of your maximum Health per second based on missing Health. Can perform Arkay's Rites.

devotee.name: Arkayn Cycle
devotee.text: Revive with full Health upon taking fatal damage. Must pray to use this ability again. Costs 50% favor. Attribute fortifying spells are up to 20% stronger.

tenets.name: Tenets of Arkay
tenets.text: Slay the undead and their summoners. Perform Arkay's Rites. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim. Never summon the undead or become one of them.

follower.name: The Eternal Sun
follower.text: Deal up to 20% more damage to vampires and take up to 20% less damage from vampires. Auriel's bow uses up to 80% less charge (based on favor with Auriel).

devotee.name: Path to Alaxon
devotee.text: Sun spells and bows are up to 20% stronger. Wearing Elven, Glass or Ancient Falmer armor set increases Glass and Elven damage by up to 20% (based on favor with Auriel).

tenets.name: Tenets of Auriel
tenets.text: Fulfill your destiny by saving Tamriel. Master all skills. Become my Champion at my sacred Chantry. High Elves are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Twilight Shroud
follower.text: Foes within mag feet can absorb spells and suffer up to 20% reduced magic resistance, chameleon and blind spells are up to 25% cheaper (based on favor with Azura)

devotee.name: Perfume of Moonshadow
devotee.text: Activate a target below 30% - 60% health (based on favor) to paralyze them with 1 Health. Soul trapping spells cost up to 40% less to cast.

tenets.name: Tenets of Azura
tenets.text: Trap souls in my name. Explore new locations. Pray only at twilight, preferably outside. Dark Elves and those skilled in Illusion are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Pariah
follower.text: Pickpocketing and selling to fences is up to 50% better. Alchemical powders deal up to 30% more damage and oils gain 2 extra uses.

devotee.name: Skooma Trick
devotee.text: Pray to ignite skooma in people's inventory within 250 feet doing massive damage (based on favor with Baan Dar). Throwing knives do up to 50% more damage. Skooma no longer can kill you.

tenets.name: Tenets of Baan Dar
tenets.text: Pick locks and pockets successfully. Khajiit and those skilled in Archery are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Blood Throne
follower.text: Your attacks deal up to 30% more damage when fighting only one opponent (based on favor with Boethiah).

devotee.name: Assassinate
devotee.text: During prayer, you may invoke superior Daedric Invisibility for 90 seconds. If broken by a sneak attack, it deals 25% more damage. Costs 10% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Boethiah
tenets.text: Murder the innocent. Slay people who stand in your way. Strike unseen with sneak attacks. Dark Elves are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Pactmaker
follower.text: Conjuration spells and effects are up to 20% stronger. Pray to make a Pact to gain favor with Clavicus Vile.

devotee.name: Wishmaster
devotee.text: Pray to make a Wish, permanently gaining an additional perk point. Costs 99% favor. Most teleporting and traversal spells are up to 50% cheaper to cast.

tenets.name: Tenets of Clavicus Vile
tenets.text: Pray to accept a Pact and complete it as written within the allotted time. Never break or ignore my Pacts.

follower.name: Afterglow
follower.text: Take up to 20% less physical and magical damage while you have 2 or more allies in combat or 1 ally and have lover's comfort.

devotee.name: Dibellan Arts
devotee.text: Activate a person in combat to make them unequip their items and follow you for 90 seconds. Costs 5% favor. Illusion spells are up to 15% stronger or longer lasting, twice that for charm, rally and command spells.

tenets.name: Tenets of Dibella
tenets.text: Persuade others. Receive the blessing of Lover's Comfort. Find a new Sybil for my Temple. Pray only in the nude. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.

follower.name: Enemy of the Daedra
follower.text: One Handed raises damage blocked, Block raises armor rating and Heavy Armor raises attack damage. 15% at 100 of the corresponding skill level. These bonuses are doubled in an Oblivion Realm.

devotee.name: Raven's Harvest
devotee.text: Transfer armor of enemies within mag feet by up to 200 (based on favor with Ebonarm). Doubled against daedra. Bonus to frost and shock resist when wearing Ebony Armor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Ebonarm
tenets.text: Slay daedra. Defeat epic foes. Complete miscellaneous quests for the people of Skyrim. Those skilled in Block are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Demon of Knowledge
follower.text: Find Eldritch Pages on corpses. Similar Eldritch Pages can be bound at a tanning rack to create Eldritch Tomes that improve magic and shouts.

devotee.name: Omniscience
devotee.text: Pray to permanently raise a skill of your choice by one level. Costs 10% favor. Entropic spells are up to 20% stronger based on favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Hermaeus Mora
tenets.text: Read Eldritch Pages and bind them into Eldritch Tomes. Read books that teach new skills. Become my Champion at the Summit of Apocrypha.

follower.name: Bitter Mercy
follower.text: Deal up to 60% more attack damage to living targets with down to 50% or less Health (based on favor with Hircine).

devotee.name: Posting of the Hunt
devotee.text: Pray to invoke a Hunt within 500 feet, revealing the living and exposing them to Bitter Mercy. Costs 10% favor. Werebeasts can now deal up to 30% more damage to undead under half health.

tenets.name: Tenets of Hircine
tenets.text: Slay the living in open combat, especially those stronger than you. Live as a werewolf. Pray in the wild. Those skilled in Light Armor are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Symbiosis
follower.text: Pray to gain up and to 50 point bonus to all attributes for up to 1000 seconds (based on favor with the Hist). Up to 100 when under the influence of Sleeping Tree Sap.

devotee.name: Deep Roots
devotee.text: Absorb up to 40% stamina and magicka from nearby dead creatures and people. Sleeping tree sap lasts up to 20 times longer and is up to 100% stronger.(based on favor with the Hist).

tenets.name: Tenets of the Hist
tenets.text: Explore new locations. Slay daedra. Pray only outdoors. Never summon a daedra.

follower.name: Make Way
follower.text: Staggering an opponent reduces armor by up to 300 points for 60 seconds (based on favor with the HoonDing).

devotee.name: Perseverance
devotee.text: The Hoonding gives you 25% chance to take no poise damage, take 25% less physical damage when not staggered, 25% more when staggered and deal 25% more weapon damage to staggered enemies.

tenets.name: Tenets of the HoonDing
tenets.text: Slay your foes in open combat, especially those stronger than you. Those skilled in One-Handed are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Forest Stride
follower.text: Take up to 20% less physical damage from non-animals or up to 50% less from animals when unarmored (Based on favor with Jephre). Eating meat is twice as strong, plant based food gives no benefit.

devotee.name: The Eternal Song
devotee.text: Health and stamina quickly restores outdoors and out of combat. Deal up to 20% more damage when unarmored. Praying to Jephre brings clear weather.

tenets.name: Tenets of Jephre
tenets.text: Explore new locations. Read the stories of others. Hunt animals. Wood Elves are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Divine Scholar
follower.text: Spells last up to 25% longer and hostile spells are up to 20% weaker (based on favor with Julianos).

devotee.name: Temple of Logic
devotee.text: Spells have up to 25% more magnitude (based on favor with Julianos).

tenets.name: Tenets of Julianos
tenets.text: Master the skills of the Mage. Strive to raise your Magicka. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.

follower.name: Obelisks of Order
follower.text: Generates 8 Obelisks of Order in Skyrim. Activating one grants 20 points of Health, Magicka and Stamina.

devotee.name: Stasis
devotee.text: Activate an opponent in combat to trap them in an inert but invulnerable state for 3 seconds. Costs 2% favor. Take no physical damage while staggered.

tenets.name: Tenets of Jyggalag
tenets.text: Activate my Obelisks of Order. Clear dungeons of evil. Slay daedra. Never serve Sheogorath. Those skilled in Heavy Armor are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Windspeaker
follower.text: Plant-based food is 50% stronger and longer lasting. When not sneaking, gain up to 25% more damage and critical damage with bows and daggers.

devotee.name: Kynareth's Emissary
devotee.text: Pray to summon a Sabre Cat mount. Friendly creatures and spirit summons are healed. Gain 10% critical hit chance with bows and dagger while not sneaking.

tenets.name: Tenets of Kynareth
tenets.text: Explore new locations. Strive to raise your Stamina. Receive the Voice of the Sky. Pray only outdoors. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.

follower.name: Spirit Sword
follower.text: All melee attacks ignore up to 30% of an opponent's armor (based on favor with Leki).

devotee.name: Battle Meditation
devotee.text: During prayer, you may spend 5% favor to gain up to 50% melee damage against targets at full hp (based on favor with Leki) for 60 minutes or 10 battles. Costs 5% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Leki
tenets.text: Bring the Civil War to a conclusion. Make and improve weapons. Master the skills of the Warrior.

follower.name: Shimmering Light
follower.text: Out of combat, gain 50 points of weapon charge per second and 5 while in combat, up to their charge level when last equipped or recharged.

devotee.name: Starlit Path
devotee.text: During prayer, you may let the Magna-Ge carry you to a location within line of sight. Costs 4% favor. Up to 10% better Cloak and Alteration spells (based on favor with The Magne Ge)

tenets.name: Tenets of the Magna-Ge
tenets.text: Create enchanted items. Explore new locations. Pray only outdoors at night. High Elves and those skilled in Alteration are most deserving of our favor.

follower.name: Sight, Light and Insight
follower.text: Magicka does not regenerate. While holding a staff or wand, touch and rune spells are up to 20% stronger or longer lasting and enchantments use 50% less charge.

devotee.name: Architect's Gift
devotee.text: Potions and ingredients restore up to 50% more magicka. When under the effects of a magicka potion, soul gems provide up to 50% more charge.

tenets.name: Tenets of Magnus
tenets.text: Practice magic successfully while praying. Safeguard the Eye of Magnus. Create enchanted items.

follower.name: Deathbringer
follower.text: Your power attacks are up to 15% stronger and cost up to 15% less stamina (based on favor with Malacath).

devotee.name: Bloodsoaked Triumph
devotee.text: When an enemy dies within mag feet, their killer is healed based on the amount of overkill damage dealt (scaling with favor with Malacath).

tenets.name: Tenets of Malacath
tenets.text: Defeat epic foes. Improve weapons and armor. Never commit a crime against the strongholds. Orcs and those skilled in Smithing are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Dark Moon
follower.text: Undead Conjurations last up to 20% longer and necrotic spells are up to 10% more powerful (based on favor with Mannimarco).

devotee.name: Nocturne
devotee.text: Undead Conjurations deal up to 20% more physical damage (based on favor with Mannimarco).

tenets.name: Tenets of Mannimarco
tenets.text: Trap souls in my name. Pray only at night. Never accept Arkay's blessing. Those skilled in Conjuration are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Cleansing
follower.text: While your hands are lowered, restore attributes 0.5 per second. Restoration spells are up to 20% stronger based on favor. Praying cures all diseases.

devotee.name: Aura of Peace
devotee.text: Living allies within mag feet are healed up to 20 points of magicka and health per second (based on favor with Mara). Take 25% less physical damage when your hands are lowered.

tenets.name: Tenets of Mara
tenets.text: Be married. Own one or more houses. Be generous to beggars and children. Receive the blessing of Lover's Comfort. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.

follower.name: Self-Immolation
follower.text: Drain magicka when praying. Stop praying at 20% or less to gain more favor and Burning Path activations. Craft potions of immolation using potions of magicka restore at the cooking pot.

devotee.name: Burning Path
devotee.text: Nearby foes burn for up to 40 damage and explode on death (based on favor with Mehrunes Dagon). Pray to recharge. Nearby friendly Daedra have their attributes healed.

tenets.name: Tenets of Mehrunes Dagon
tenets.text: Slay people who stand in your way. Defile the shrines of my enemies. Those skilled in Destruction are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Secret Murder
follower.text: Sneak attacks deal up to 20% more damage from behind when not wearing heavy armor (based on favor with Mephala).

devotee.name: Whispers of Betrayal
devotee.text: During prayer, seize control of the nearest person within 75 feet to fight for you. Costs 5% favor. Follower ability buffed to up to 30% sneak damage.

tenets.name: Tenets of Mephala
tenets.text: Poison your weapons. Strike unseen with sneak attacks. Intimidate the weak. Dark Elves are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Purification
follower.text: Fire, Turning and Sun spells are up to 20% better. Physical attacks are up to 30% better against undead. (based on favor with Meridia).

devotee.name: Supreme Light
devotee.text: Activate an undead opponent in combat to call down a solar strike to deal massive damage to undead in a wide area. Costs 50% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Meridia
tenets.text: Slay the undead. Never summon the undead or become one of them. High Elves and those skilled in Restoration are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Eye of the Storm
follower.text: Absorbs up to 10 Magicka and Stamina per second (based on favor with Molag Bal) from nearby enemies in combat.

devotee.name: Dragged to Oblivion
devotee.text: Activate a hostile below level 50 in combat to banish them to Coldharbour. Pray to request the items. Costs 25% favor. Blood magic is up to 20% stronger.

tenets.name: Tenets of Molag Bal
tenets.text: Slay people who stand in your way. Trap souls in my name. Live as a vampire and never seek a cure. Those skilled in Destruction are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Healer of the Sands
follower.text: Meditation restores up to 200 Health for you and allies out of combat (based on favor with Morwha). Some enemies can drop milk or honey. This can be used to create a curative potion.

devotee.name: Fertile Growth
devotee.text: Praying to Morwha blesses you with enchanted fruit that restores or fortifies an attribute. These fruits can be further improved using milk and honey.

tenets.name: Tenets of Morwha
tenets.text: Be married. Receive the blessing of Lover's Comfort. Harvest the fruits of nature. Eat as much food as you want.

follower.name: Creeping Decay
follower.text: Reduces Poison Resist of all within mag feet by up to 40% (based on favor with Namira). Grants strong stomach and strange meat on kills.

devotee.name: Necrophages
devotee.text: Poisoning a person or putting a Human Heart, Flesh or Strange Meat into their inventory attracts insects, reducing armor by  up to 20 and dealing up to 40 disease damage (based on favor with Namira).

tenets.name: Tenets of Namira
tenets.text: Murder the innocent. Poison your weapons. Eat the corpses of the dead with my Ring. Be generous to beggars.

follower.name: Vanish in the Night
follower.text: Praying clears non-violent crime bounties up to up to 5000 gold. Shadow spells are up to 30% better and 50% at night (based on favor with Nocturnal).

devotee.name: Raven's Watch
devotee.text: During the night, you are much less likely to be detected and are more proficient with picking pockets. During prayer, you may astrally observe the nearest person within 300 feet.

tenets.name: Tenets of Nocturnal
tenets.text: Pickpocket Mysterious Coinpurses. Pick locks successfully. Pray only at night, preferably in darkness. Those skilled in Sneak are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Totem Worship
follower.text: Pray while sacrificing 100 gold worth of gemstones to assume the powers of an animal god. Deal & up to 15% more or less damage when wearing full Forsworn, Fur, Leather or Hide.

devotee.name: Dragon Cult
devotee.text: Able to assume the powers of the Dragon. Costs 2% favor per hour. Frost spells are up to 20% stronger based on favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of the Old Ways
tenets.text: Slay people who stand in your way. Absorb dragon souls. Assume our powers through prayer. Nords are most deserving of our favor.

follower.name: Taskmaster
follower.text: Poison spells are up to 20% stronger or longer lasting (based on favor with Peryite). Pray for Peryite's Gifts to gain favor.

devotee.name: Green Dragon's Breath
devotee.text: Activate a living opponent in combat to inflict all of Peryite's Gifts you have on the target, plus 20 disease damage per second for each gift. Pray to recharge.

tenets.name: Tenets of Peryite
tenets.text: Catch as many diseases as you can. Accept my Gifts of pestilence. Pray only while diseased. Never accept a cure for your afflictions.

follower.name: Shorter Strides
follower.text: Take up to 20% less damage based on favor, immunity to stagger and 50% attribute regeneration while standing still.

devotee.name: Elvenpath
devotee.text: During prayer, you may teleport back to the last location where you prayed. Gain to 25% absorb chance and 100% poison and disease resist while not moving.

tenets.name: Tenets of Phynaster
tenets.text: Explore new locations. Find the standing stones of Skyrim. Harvest the fruits of nature. Bretons are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Rajhin's Tales
follower.text: Chance to find a large amount of additional gold in containers. Most sneak or thieving related potions and spells last up to twice as long.

devotee.name: Prayer of Unlocking
devotee.text: Pray to Rajhin to break a pickable lock within 20 feet. No fall damage if not wearing heavy armor and chance to gain valuable loot on slain enemies while tresspassing.

tenets.name: Tenets of Rajhin
tenets.text: Explore new locations. Bribe people as needed. Pick locks successfully. Those skilled in Lockpicking are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Path to Llesw'er
follower.text: Gain bonuses based on day of the week ranging from attribute boosts, attribute regeneration and resistances.

devotee.name: Beseech the Manes
devotee.text: During prayer, an ancient Mane will grant a blessing they believe to be appropriate. Double bonus from day cycles.

tenets.name: Tenets of Riddle'Thar
tenets.text: Master the skills of the Warrior, Thief and Mage. Strive to raise your Health, Magicka and Stamina. Each is as important as the others. Pray only at night.

follower.name: Dancing Step
follower.text: Pray to bet gold on a game of dice. When sprinting, move 10% faster and restore 1 Health and Stamina per second. When not sprinting, move 10% slower and lose 100% health and stamina regeneration.

devotee.name: High Stakes
devotee.text: Staking 1000 gold or more on a game of dice also adds 1 point of Stamina to your wager.

tenets.name: Tenets of Sai
tenets.text: Gamble while meditating and win.

follower.name: Be Merry
follower.text: Regeneration is increaesed by 100% while alcohol, skooma or any other harmful alchemy effects are active. Alcohol is up to 100% stronger based on favor with Sanguine.

devotee.name: Pandemonium
devotee.text: Can pray in combat, forcing the 5 nearest hostile people to dance for 20 seconds. Dancing targets take up to 20% more damage. Costs 10% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Sanguine
tenets.text: Make mischief and commit misdemeanors and crimes worthy of a bounty. Indulge in mead, wine and ale. Find your own way out of jail.

follower.name: World Egg
follower.text: Shrine blessings from any other gods are up to 75% more effective and last longer (based on favor with Satakal).

devotee.name: Ouroboros
devotee.text: Pray to become reborn as a different person, moving points between your attributes. Costs 15% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Satakal
tenets.text: Fulfill your destiny by saving Tamriel. Strive to raise your Health. Absorb dragon souls.

follower.name: Touch of Madness
follower.text: Praying grants a random Touch of Madness. High favor with Sheogorath yields more beneficial effects. Cheese is 200% stronger.

devotee.name: Lost to Madness
devotee.text: Receive a Touch of Madness whenever you enter combat. All skills level 25 or below are 20% better.

tenets.name: Tenets of Sheogorath
tenets.text: Pray often and receive Sheogorath's Touch of Madness. Never disrespect cheese.

follower.name: Another Name for Freedom
follower.text: Take almost no poise damage, deal up to 15% more and take up to 15% less physical damage against non-humans or animals (based on favor with Shor).

devotee.name: Destiny
devotee.text: When in combat with a mighty foe, Shor sends a Shield-Thane to assist. Pray to recharge. Elemental resistance increased by 15%.

tenets.name: Tenets of Shor
tenets.text: Fulfill your destiny by saving Tamriel. Master the skills of the Warrior. Slay elves. Defeat epic foes.

follower.name: Primal Darkness
follower.text: Up to 25% harder to detect by those within 30 feet. Chance to find Human Hearts on people you kill.

devotee.name: Call of the Void
devotee.text: While sneaking, activate a door to briefly turn it into a Void portal. Targets within 60 feet who are not detecting you are pulled in and killed. Costs 5% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Sithis
tenets.text: Murder the innocent. Pray while sacrificing a Human Heart or Human Flesh. Send your victims to the Void. Argonians are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Seht's Guidance
follower.text: Items are enchanted up to 15% stronger and telekentic and wind spells are up to 20% better (based on favor with Sotha Sil).

devotee.name: Seht's Brilliance
devotee.text: Using a filled soul gem or dynamo core, permanently summon a Dwarven automaton to fight for you (Max 1). Shock spells are up to 20% stronger based on favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Sotha Sil
tenets.text: Uncover the secrets of Dwemer ruins. Create enchanted items. Master the skills of the Mage. Dark Elves and those skilled in Enchanting are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Covenant of Man
follower.text: Pray for a Divine blessing of your choice. Divine blessings are up to 100% better. Take up to 20% less damage from humans (based on favor with St. Alessia).

devotee.name: Dragonblood Empress
devotee.text: While under the effects of a Divine blessing, can talk to most non-hostile humans to make them a friend and potential follower. Costs 10% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of St. Alessia
tenets.text: Have a follower at your side. Slay elves. Receive the blessing of a Divine.

follower.name: Sacred Resolve
follower.text: Physical attacks against undead slowly restore your health. Take up to 50% less attack damage from all attacks as your health decreases. (based on favor with Stendarr).

devotee.name: Channel Divinity
devotee.text: During prayer, you may spend 10% favor to gain up to 40% improved attack, defense and healing (based on favor with Stendarr) for 120 seconds or 3 battles.

tenets.name: Tenets of Stendarr
tenets.text: Clear dungeons of evil. Slay daedra and the undead. Complete side quests. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim. Never practice the foul summoning arts.

follower.name: Knowledge Seeker
follower.text: You are more likely to find spell tomes, staves and scrolls on enemies you kill. Arcane spells are up to 20% stronger based on favor.

devotee.name: Reach for the Stars
devotee.text: All spells cost up to 20% less to cast (based on favor with Syrabane).

tenets.name: Tenets of Syrabane
tenets.text: Read books that teach new skills. Study a wide variety of spells. High Elves are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Metaphysical Insight
follower.text: Bound weapons deal up to 20% more base damage and bound armor provides 30% more armor rating (based on favor with Tall Papa).

devotee.name: Glimpse the Shores
devotee.text: On death, become ethereal for a time period based on favor. If combat ends while ethereal, brings you back to life 10% favor. Pray to reset. Ghosts deal up to 50% less damage to you.

tenets.name: Tenets of Tall Papa
tenets.text: Touch the Fractures scattered around Skyrim. Create enchanted items. Those skilled in Enchanting are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Stormlord
follower.text: Attacks and shouts against playable races, Snow Elves and Falmer are increased by up to 20% (based on favor with Talos).

devotee.name: Dragon of the North
devotee.text: Your remaining shout cooldown is halved whenever an enemy dies within mag feet.

tenets.name: Tenets of Talos
tenets.text: Bring the Civil War to a conclusion. Learn the dragon tongue. Absorb dragon souls. Slay elves and the Thalmor. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.

follower.name: Tears of Man
follower.text: Gain 20% attack damage if health is above 90% and 20% if stamina is above 90% (based on favor with Trinimac).

devotee.name: Manifest Divinity
devotee.text: When praying, you may become ethereal and invulnerable until your next attack. Costs 5% favor.

tenets.name: Tenets of Trinimac
tenets.text: Slay humans. Defeat epic foes. Never accept Boethiah's blessing or serve her. Those skilled in Two-Handed are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Night Terrors
follower.text: Mind affecting illusion spells are up to 20% more effective and cost up to 50% less magicka while out of combat (based on favor with Vaermina).

devotee.name: Phantasmagoria
devotee.text: Activate a sleeping person to summon an illusion to accompany you for ten hours. Costs 20% favor. Illusion spells are up to 10% stronger when not rested.

tenets.name: Tenets of Vaermina
tenets.text: Witness the death of those under your mind affecting spells. Kill people in their sleep. Sleep to pray. Those skilled in Illusion are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Vehk's Guile
follower.text: Speech and intimidate checks are up to 60% easier and light attacks deal up to 30% more damage (per favor with Vivec)

devotee.name: Might of the Armiger
devotee.text: Critical hits chance and damage is increased by up to 20% when not power attacking. (based on favor with Vivec). Your health, stamina and magicka attempt to reach equilibrium.

tenets.name: Tenets of Vivec
tenets.text: Fulfill your destiny by saving Tamriel. Read the stories of others. Defeat epic foes. Dark Elves and those skilled in Speechcraft are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Scribe's Insight
follower.text: 2 additional skill point from skill books. Scrolls scale based on enchanting skill 20% at level 100 enchanting.

devotee.name: Panopticon
devotee.text: Pray to ascend in a trance, revealing all characters in a very large radius. Scrolls scale based on you magic skill level of the scroll type 20% at 100 skill level.

tenets.name: Tenets of Xarxes
tenets.text: Explore new locations. Read the stories of others. Study a wide variety of spells. Bretons are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Traveler's Break
follower.text: Alchemy is up to 15% more effective (based on favor with Z'en). Gain 1 extra potion crafted.

devotee.name: Merchant's Knapsack
devotee.text: Pray to open and trade with an unlimited extradimensional storage space which has 5000 gold. Gain 2 more poison doses before needing to re-apply the poison.

tenets.name: Tenets of Z'en
tenets.text: Bribe people as needed. Harvest the fruits of nature. Eat as much food as you want. Those skilled in Speech are most deserving of my favor.

follower.name: Work Ethic
follower.text: Tempering weapons or armor is up to 15% better and unenchanted weapons deal up to 10% more damage (based on favor with Zenithar).

devotee.name: Invisible Hand
devotee.text: Pray to Zenithar to buy and sell items directly. Gain a very difficult crafting recipe. This recipe allows you to create perk potions at the Aetherium Forge.

tenets.name: Tenets of Zenithar
tenets.text: Invest in stores and merchants. Seek out skill training. Make weapons and armor. Never openly break the laws of Skyrim.
